High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Arica (PC Errata 3)]] (the card with its Players Committee errata text and the errata mark) (Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Arica _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xhzOQ7mi0FV9254Bd5kxjeFoAj64RcMT/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Arica _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,384 bytes, SHA-256 <code>4d37a95c7a0dc5abab527e8bfa7a9b2073ec18fc7ba05bba8d33e21878484cb3</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

This credited print-ready fan recreation uses an original-style frame and gold E mark. It is an explicitly qualified comparison, not an automatic same-image high-resolution scan of the documentary source or official full D-E1 face at [[Arica (PC Errata 3)]]. Original TIFF, master, credit and license provenance remain unchanged.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (card design by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
